content:
ashley: Follow-up: propose replacing static queue cutoff with an adaptive multi-tier admit. Goals: fewer abrupt rejects, graceful degradation, clear telemetry.

matt: tiers?

ashley: 1) admit normally 2) soft-queue (accept but mark) 3) fallback to cheaper model 4) reject.

jin: must not break streaming protocol.

ashley: we keep streaming API surface; attach header `X-RI-Degraded` and emit a final trailer event describing fallback.

alex: need clear billing/metric flags and opt-in for side-effecting routes.

ashley: agreed. fallback only for non-side-effect routes or client opt-in. emit sampling spans when fallback used.

sarah: threshold calc? static qlen bad.

matt: use percentile-based adaptive threshold (p95 concurrency) with token-bucket smoothing.

jin: streaming should be weighted (estimated remaining tokens / 128) so long-lived streams aren't equal to short calls.

ashley: example config: {"admission.window_secs":"30","p95_multiplier":"1.15","soft_queue.capacity":"200","soft_queue.soft_ttl_ms":"250"}

alex: prevent oscillation when fallback shifts load. cooldown per-tenant + global backstop.

jin: add hysteresis: only revert fallback after smoothed_inflight < threshold*0.85 for 60s.

ashley: disallow mid-stream model swaps; fallback only at start/admission time.

sre-bot: deploy-canary started: canary-2026-03-21-01 -> https://ci/internal/canary/2026-03-21-01

ashley: rollout: dry-run -> canary -> 10% -> full.

ashley: actions: RFC update (me), impl (matt+jin), canary+dashboard (sre+sarah), client docs (alex).
